name: app-shell
title: App Shell
description: The shared dashboard layout — a skip-linked sidebar + header + scrollable main region, composing Sidebar/SidebarTrigger into one reusable, hash-tracked shell.

meta.whenToUse: The root layout for a dashboard/console app — sidebar + header + main content, shared across every downstream VegaStack app.
meta.whenNotToUse: A marketing/docs page with no persistent nav rail, or an app that already owns an equivalent shell — compose Sidebar/PageHeader/Breadcrumb directly instead.
